data.name: Najooba
data.gender_notes: Najooba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'najaba', which means 'to ask for forgiveness'. This name embodies the spirit of seeking forgiveness and showing compassion towards others. It is a beautiful name for a girl, reflecting the gentle and graceful nature of a beloved daughter. The name Najooba carries the meaning “Graceful, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najooba usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Najooba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najooba total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
